limitations: Attention-call scope only; no complete-model or backward performance claim.
First pilot memcheck exited 88 for cuGetProcAddress/version API reporting warnings; repeat using report-api-errors no passed. Original warning logs retained.
Original production compiled-case harness exhausted Dynamo per-code cache; independent cases now reset cache without changing production limits. Original failure retained.

Original FA2 code adapter assumed a single flash_fwd_kernel; D256 actually launches splitKV and combine. Adaptive capture first failed before GPU work because the extension import preceded torch; a new immutable code-only continuation corrected import order and binds both kernels. Original failures retained.
Hardware performance counters unavailable in the prior retained GB10 attempt; no stall, utilization or bandwidth-ceiling claim.
